notes.title: Big update
A big update is getting ready
notes.notes: A major update is being prepared, which will bring the game to a new level of quality. Most of the upcoming innovations are ready, so the approximate release date for the update is one month.

notes.title: New level
notes.notes: Hello, in the next update a new level will be opened which at the time of release will not be available in the level selection menu. The level is a small area with linear passage.

notes.title: Little trouble with russian interface
notes.notes: Hello, we tried to make the Russian interface for players from the Russian Federation. But some minor elements still remain in English. And this should not affect the understanding of what is happening in the game for russian players. In the future we will try to fix it. Have fun game!
